data.title: Creek Gate
data.about:
Welcome to Creek Gate located within the much-coveted Dubai Creek Harbour. 

Offering an exclusive waterfront lifestyle, this tower gives you the choice of 1, 2, & 3 bedroom apartments. Overlooking the blue sea of the Arabian Gulf, Creek Gate gives you the best of both worlds: The perfect city life & absolute tranquility paired perfectly with the community lifestyle you need to thrive and grow within.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury residential apartments by Emaar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Choice of 1, 2 and 3 Bedrooms
  • Enviable views of the tallest tower “The Tower”
  • Pay 40% on Handover – Completion Aug 2020*
  • Located near the heart of the Island District of Dubai Creek Harbour
  • A gateway to the Island District
  • Clear line of sight to The Tower and overlooking the Island Central Park
  • Private Pools, Gym, Children’s Area, Private Parking and a Landscape Leisure Park
  • Concept of Urban Living with retail, Café and Restaurants
